thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired PD-78512 -> model-catalog: default-revision drift detected for model 'redwood-small-1'. Tokenizer mismatch alerts. auto-escalation to on-call.
Sasha: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now. Any known customer impact?
PagerDuty: PD-78512 acknowledged by Sasha.
Sasha: quick dump - catalog shows defaultRevision=2026-03-15-77 but tokenizer metadata is v2 while expected v1. downstream decode errors + 502 spikes on route /v1/chat/completions. tagging @Michael @Nina.
Michael: on my way. can we pin the route to previous revision while we analyze? @Devon can you pause autopromote?
Nina: CS: 3 customers with elevated errors (AcmeCorp, BrightHealth, SwiftDocs). Tickets opened, sending interim update.
Devon: autopromote job stopped. Applying manual pin now:
```bash
kubectl -n catalog patch modelconfig redwood-small-1 --type 'json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/defaultRevision","value":"2026-03-14-49"}]'
```
Sasha: thanks @Devon. I'm creating a temporary route override to fallback to quantized-compat variant while we validate artifacts.
Sasha: route override command:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/routes/override" -d '{"model":"redwood-small-1","target":"redwood-small-1:2026-03-14-49","reason":"tokenizer-mismatch-fallback"}'
```
deploy-bot: route override deployed -> redwood-small-1 now routed to redwood-small-1:2026-03-14-49 in us-west-2.
Michael: verifying traffic. error rate falling back to baseline (~1%). Good so far. Need to rollback bad defaults from catalog and add pre-promotion validation.
Nina: CS has sent customer comms: short incident note + workaround. No data leakage. Will continue to update affected accounts.
Sasha: filing a hotfix PR to reject promotions when tokenizer hash != model artifact tokenizer. PR #4123 created and assigned to @Devon. Also adding canary checks for tokenizer/metadata consistency.
PagerDuty: PD-78512 marked as Mitigated by Sasha. Will close after confirmation window.
Michael: will follow up with infra test and a small validation job to run on promotion events. Adding to backlog and scheduling short follow-up meeting.
Nina: initial impact summary for postmortem: ~420 failed requests/min peak over ~7 minutes, 3 SLA alerts triggered. Owner for postmortem: Nina. RCA target in 48h.
Sasha: handing off follow-ups to @Michael and @Devon. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :white_check_mark:
Michael: noted, I'll own the rollout guard and infra validation.
Nina: I'll draft the incident summary and timeline and post to #incidents.
Sasha: closing thread here, will update if anything else pops up. :lock_with_ink_pen:
